mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(fymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM USPM_PORT t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TYMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , t1.WONBON_AEK AS wonbon_aek , t1.JM_PER AS jm_per , t1.USD_WONBON_AEK AS usd_wonbon_aek , ROUND(t1.USD_WONBON_AEK * NVL(t1.JM_PER, 0) / 100, 2) AS usd_tuja , sonik.jm_sonik AS jm_sonik , sonik.pg_sonik AS pg_sonik , sonik.pg_premium AS pg_premium , sonik.put_premium AS premium , sonik.un_sonik AS un_sonik FROM SZT0IA_V t1 , SZM0IA ia , (SELECT ta.FUND_CD , SUM(NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK,0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK,0)) AS jm_sonik , SUM(ta.JM_PG_SONIK) AS pg_sonik , SUM(ta.PUT_PG_PREMIUM) AS pg_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.PUT_BF_PREMIUM,0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM,0)) AS put_premium , SUM(NVL(ta.PUT_BF_PREMIUM,0) + NVL(ta.SA3_PREMIUM,0) + NVL(ta.JM_BF_SONIK,0) + NVL(ta.JM_UP_SONIK,0) + NVL(ta.JM_PG_SONIK,0)) AS un_sonik FROM USPM_SONIK ta WHERE ta.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND ta.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY ta.FUND_CD) sonik WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND NVL(t1.DEL,'N') = 'N' AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND sonik.fund_cd(+) = t1.FUND_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , NVL(ya.JM_NM, jj.JJ_NM) AS jm_nm , NVL(ya.JM_NM, jj.JJ_NM) AS xx_yj_cd , ya.BLBG_TCKR AS srs_cd , t1.JONGA AS syt0lp_jonga , t1.MARKET_CAPITALIZATION AS market_capitalization , t1.DAYS AS days , t1.SHORT_PRICE AS short_price , t1.GIJUN_PRICE AS gijun_price , t1.D30_VOLATILITY AS d30_volatility , t1.G30_VOLATILITY AS g30_volatility , hl.HIGH_VALUE AS high_value , TO_CHAR(hl.HIGH_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS high_ymd , hl.LOW_VALUE AS low_value , TO_CHAR(hl.LOW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS low_ymd , CASE WHEN t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD='KRX' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS ovrs_excg_cd FROM USPM t1 LEFT JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD LEFT JOIN SJM0JJ jj ON jj.KOSCOM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND jj.DANC_GB IN ('A','C') , TABLE(F_HIGH_LOW(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) hl WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND (ya.JM_CD IS NOT NULL OR jj.KOSCOM_CD IS NOT NULL) AND hl.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY CASE WHEN t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD='KRX' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END, NVL(ya.JM_NM, jj.JJ_NM)

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.PORT AS port , t1.JONGA AS jonga , lp.TVOL AS tvol , lp.TOMV AS tomv , t1.STOCK_JUSU AS stock_jusu , t1.STOCK_CHUI AS stock_chui , t1.OPT_QTY AS opt_qty , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , t1.OPT_PREMIUM AS opt_premium , tt.risk_value AS risk_value , 'N' AS is_krx FROM USPM_OPT t1 , SYT0LP lp , (SELECT yz.YMD , yz.FUND_CD , yz.TRUSTEE , ya.CHANGE_JM_CD , SUM(NVL(yz.DELTA_RISK_VALUE,0) + NVL(yz.GAMMA_RISK_VALUE,0) + NVL(yz.VEGA_RISK_VALUE,0)) AS risk_value FROM SYM0YZ yz , SYM0YA ya WHERE yz.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND yz.YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ya.CORP_GR = yz.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = yz.JM_CD GROUP BY yz.YMD, yz.FUND_CD, yz.TRUSTEE, ya.CHANGE_JM_CD) tt WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.YMD NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD FROM SZX0HL ta WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US' AND ta.HOLI_YMD >= TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND lp.CORP_GR(+) = t1.CORP_GR AND lp.YMD(+) = t1.YMD AND lp.JM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD AND tt.YMD(+) = t1.YMD AND tt.FUND_CD(+) = t1.FUND_CD AND tt.TRUSTEE(+) = t1.PORT AND tt.CHANGE_JM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC, t1.PORT ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.PORT AS port , t1.JONGA AS jonga , tg.VOLUME AS volume , tg.VALUE AS value , t1.STOCK_JUSU AS stock_jusu , t1.STOCK_CHUI AS stock_chui , t1.OPT_QTY AS opt_qty , t1.OPT_NOMINAL_AMT AS opt_nominal_amt , t1.OPT_PREMIUM AS opt_premium , NULL AS risk_value , 'Y' AS is_krx FROM USPM_OPT t1 , SJT1TG tg WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.YMD BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.YMD NOT IN (SELECT HOLI_YMD FROM SZX0HL ta WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'KR' AND ta.HOLI_YMD >= TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND tg.YMD(+) = t1.YMD AND tg.KOSCOM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC, t1.PORT ASC
